description:
Data Scientist (Growth) at Quillion

Quillion is a reading subscription service (180k paying subscribers, growing ~14% QoQ). We're hiring our second data scientist, focused on growth — acquisition, activation, retention.

Scope
- Own the retention model. Our current version is a logistic regression from 2023 that does not merit the name 'model'. Rebuild it.
- Run the weekly cohort review with the growth team. Not a dashboard — a narrative.
- Set up the experimentation framework. Today PMs copy a template Google Doc. That's not a system.
- Partner with the data engineer on warehouse cleanup. Yes, there's tech debt.

What we care about
- 4+ years doing data science at a consumer subscription product.
- Python, SQL, pandas, one of scikit-learn / PyTorch / statsmodels.
- You can tell us a story about an experiment that changed a decision. The number on the dashboard is not the story.
- Strong writing. We're suspicious of data scientists who can't write.

Nice extras
- Experience with causal inference techniques (DiD, synthetic control).
- Prior work at a subscription or media company.
